verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's own API covers each part of the story. It returns page content as markdown via `return_page_markdown`, renders JavaScript by default, and handles blocking through premium proxies and an auto mode that escalates until a request succeeds. `ai_query` adds semantic extraction on top. missing for 10: detail on how clean the markdown output is (boilerplate or nav stripping, plain-text option), and independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM-ready output quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get clean LLM-ready text directly instead of dealing with blocking, rendering, and messy HTML myself

citations.quote: return_page_markdown [boolean] (false) Return the page content in markdown format
JavaScript rendering is enabled by default.
premium_proxy [boolean] (false) Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites
Let ScrapingBee pick the cheapest configuration that succeeds.
ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI
